mapper.select:
select bm.parent_id as parentId, bm.id as id, bm.menu_name as menuName from bean_menu bm
and bm.menu_name like concat('%',#{menuName},'%')
and bm.type != 3
and bm.status = 1
order by `order` asc

select bm.* from bean_menu bm,sys_tenant_connect_menu stcp,bean_user bu where bm.id = stcp.menu_id and stcp.tenant_id = bu.tenant_id and bu.id = #{userId} and bm.status = 1 and bm.id like concat('%',':list')

select bm.* from bean_menu bm,bean_user_connect_role bucr,bean_role_connect_menu brcp where bm.id = brcp.menu_id and brcp.role_id = bucr.role_id and bm.status = 1 and bucr.user_id = #{userId} and bm.id like concat('%',':list')

select bm.* from bean_menu bm,bean_user_connect_department bucr,bean_department_connect_menu brcp where bm.id = brcp.menu_id and brcp.department_id = bucr.department_id and bm.status = 1 and bucr.user_id = #{userId} and bm.id like concat('%',':list')

select bm.* from bean_menu bm,bean_user_connect_position bucr,bean_position_connect_menu brcp where bm.id = brcp.menu_id and brcp.position_id = bucr.position_id and bm.status = 1 and bucr.user_id = #{userId} and bm.id like concat('%',':list')

select bm.* from bean_menu bm
and bm.menu_name like concat('%',#{menuName},'%')
order by bm.order asc

select bm.* from bean_menu bm
and bm.status = 1
order by `order`
select bm.* from bean_menu bm,sys_tenant_connect_menu stcp where bm.id = stcp.menu_id and stcp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bm.status = 1 order by `order`
